theme: Turning on features that depend on each other
title: Rollout Order Under Flag Dependencies
innovation_hook: Enabling flags in value order hits invalid combinations that must be rolled back, wasting rollout windows. The insight is treating it as ordering under a constraint graph so every prefix is a valid configuration.
strategies: trivial: enable only flags with zero REQUIRES and zero CONFLICTS, in index order (reproduces the checker baseline B -> ~0.1)

greedy: each window chase the highest-value ready flag; if it conflicts with an active flag, roll back the cheapest active blocker to make room -- optimal on independent-flag warm-ups, but thrashes (evict/re-enable churn) on tightly coupled conflict clusters, burning windows and permanently forfeiting rolled-back flags

strong: search subsets of flags that are REQUIRES-closed and CONFLICTS-independent (every prefix of any enabling order is automatically valid), then order the chosen subset by ready-highest-value-first so no rollback is ever needed
invalid: repeatedly re-touches the same flag -> rejected
